summary: Creates, combines, converts, renames, and edits named point or primitive groups. Groups can be built from attribute tests, thinning rules, index pattern matching, existing groups, or bounding ranges, then used by downstream POPs to limit operations.

key_params.name: grname
key_params.note: Name of the group to create

key_params.name: debugcolor
key_params.note: Adds a color attribute for group debugging

key_params.name: attr0inattr
key_params.note: Attribute used by an attribute-condition block

key_params.name: attr0value
key_params.note: Comparison value for an attribute-condition block

key_params.name: pattern0pattern
key_params.note: Index pattern used by a pattern-selection block

key_params.name: thinstep
key_params.note: Selects every Nth element when thinning is enabled

key_params.name: cnvttype
key_params.note: Convert a group between point and primitive classes

key_concepts: Creates named point or primitive groups for downstream POPs that expose Group parameters.
Group membership can be built from attribute comparisons, thinning, pattern matching, existing groups, or bounding volumes.
Sequential condition blocks combine predicate logic while preserving order-sensitive generation structure.
The Edit page can rename, convert, or otherwise transform groups after initial creation.
common_gotchas: Groups only affect downstream POPs that explicitly reference them; creating a group does not delete or transform data by itself.
Complex group logic is built from sequential parameter blocks, so preserve block order when generating plans.
Prefer authoring a helper attribute with Math Mix or GLSL POP when the grouping predicate is easier as math than as Group POP blocks.
